title: The Lord's Promise to Restore Jerusalem
description: The Lord promises to return to Zion and make Jerusalem the City of Truth, where elders sit safely in the squares and children play freely. He will rescue His people from east and west, bring a season of peace with abundant harvests, and turn Judah and Israel from a curse into a blessing among the nations. The people are called to speak truth, judge fairly, and turn away from evil. [ref:Zechariah 8:1-17|Zechariah 8:1-17]
